ambientalpe.title: AmbientalPE
ambientalpe.description: Three pieces for a cohesive presence: corporate website, social media strategy and internal management system. AmbientalPE, a leader in environmental and occupational monitoring.

ambientalpe.solution: We built the ecosystem in three layers. First, the web: ambientalpe.com with services (environmental monitoring, occupational monitoring, plans and maps, equipment rental and sales), online catalog and contact. Second, social media: content and designs to communicate and connect. Third, the system: dashboard and modules for clients (credit line), suppliers, equipment (inventory, calibration), quotes and orders. Three services that support each other.
ambientalpe.projectDescription: AmbientalPE came with a clear vision: they needed three things that worked as one. The web was the starting point —ambientalpe.com—, where their environmental and occupational monitoring services, equipment catalog and contact channel are presented today. From there, we designed the social media strategy: content and visual pieces that reinforce the message and bring the brand closer to its audience. Finally, we developed the management system: an internal panel to manage clients, suppliers, equipment (inventory, calibration, status), quotes and orders. Three services, one story: digital presence, communication and operations aligned.

store-saas.solution: We built a SaaS with Next.js that integrates: product catalog with categories, collections and variants (size, color), prices and descriptions; inventory per variant with restock threshold and notifications; Kardex; online orders and POS; dashboard with revenue, orders, clients, sales trend and payment methods; coupons, content and page builder; multi-store and team management.
store-saas.projectDescription: E-commerce & Inventory SaaS is a platform we created that combines online store and inventory system in one product. Built with Next.js and TypeScript for scalability and maintainability.
store-saas.forWhom: Stores and brands that sell online and need catalog, orders, inventory and analytics control in one platform

financial-management.title: Financial Management System
financial-management.description: Integrated financial management system to digitize accounting processes and regulatory compliance: SUNAT electronic record synchronization, bank account management with automated reconciliation, supplier database and chart of accounts tracking. Includes transaction matching, comprehensive reporting and tax compliance management.
financial-management.problem: A platform was needed to unify document management (vouchers, series, amounts, status), SUNAT validation and synchronization, bank account and reconciliation administration, supplier registry, chart of accounts and journal entries, and reporting and audit for compliance and financial decisions.
financial-management.solution: I designed and built a financial management system with Next.js that integrates: document management (type, series-number, dates, supplier, tax ID, subtotal, tax, total, withholding, pending, status); SUNAT validation and withholdings; bank accounts with reconciliation; movements with Excel/CSV import; accounting and journal entry templates; reports, CONCAR, audit logs and analytics.
financial-management.projectDescription: Financial Management System is a platform I designed and built to digitize accounting processes and regulatory compliance. The solution incorporates SUNAT electronic record synchronization, bank account management with automated reconciliation, supplier database administration, and detailed chart of accounts tracking. It delivers specialized capabilities for financial transaction matching, comprehensive reporting, and tax compliance management, providing businesses with a centralized system that optimizes financial operations and maintains precise accounting standards.
financial-management.forWhom: Businesses that need to centralize accounts payable, bank reconciliation, SUNAT compliance and accounting reports in one platform

feedback-management.title: Feedback Management System
feedback-management.description: Customer experience platform to optimize feedback collection and analysis: service evaluations, suggestion management, instructor performance analytics, and multi-branch administration. Includes NPS metrics, prioritization systems, and interactive dashboards.
feedback-management.problem: A unified ecosystem was needed that combined service evaluation, suggestion management (status, priority, branch, area), ratings with NPS, analytics by instructor and branch, personnel management (managers, supervisors), and categorization by areas to turn feedback into concrete quality and satisfaction improvements.
feedback-management.solution: I created this specialized platform with modules for suggestions (filters by status, priority, branch, area; KPIs for total, pending, resolved, resolution rate); ratings (general average, NPS, instructor rating; breakdown by cleanliness, audio, attention, amenities, punctuality); personnel management (manager/supervisor roles, contact, branches, status); instructors and locations; areas to categorize suggestions; and analytics with branch and instructor rankings and interactive dashboards.
feedback-management.projectDescription: I created this customer experience platform to optimize feedback collection and analysis. The core purpose was to develop a unified ecosystem featuring service evaluations, suggestion management, instructor performance analytics, and multi-branch administration. I integrated advanced metrics like NPS, prioritization systems, and interactive dashboards that enable businesses to transform feedback into concrete quality and satisfaction improvements.
feedback-management.forWhom: Businesses and multi-branch chains that need to centralize suggestions, ratings, NPS analytics and administration by location and instructor
